dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and continuous lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical deviations, bulges, or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse light-grey patterning across the dorsal surface with no high-frequency dark-pixel clusters.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between subtle tonal variations of grey and off-white.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, sharply defined longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a distinct shadow on the left lateral plane.
